def find_smallest_n(n_str, substring):
    # Find all possible starting positions of the substring in the number
    possible_starts = [i for i in range(len(n_str) - len(substring) + 2)]
    
    # Initialize the smallest number found
    smallest_n = None
    
    # Try each possible starting position
    for start in possible_starts:
        # Create a candidate number by inserting the substring at the current start position
        candidate = n_str[:start] + substring + n_str[start:]
        
        # Check if the candidate number is valid (non-decreasing order of digits)
        if all(candidate[i] <= candidate[i+1] for i in range(len(candidate) - 1)):
            # Update the smallest number found if this is the smallest so far
            if smallest_n is None or candidate < smallest_n:
                smallest_n = candidate
    
    return smallest_n
